limitations: Shape and finiteness checks do not establish physical units, channel identity or temporal spacing. Arbitrary RGB or unrelated numeric channels do not satisfy the semantic contract merely by matching shape.
Caller must justify spatial transformation invariance and target alignment in any new application. This is a fixed two-branch recipe; generic temporal averaging is not implemented.

Distinct keys do not prove independent subjects, locations, times or arrays. Scoring participates in diagnostics and is not an independent final evaluation. Annotation means must retain their intended meaning.
Prepared state is neither deeply immutable nor a safe untrusted deserialization boundary. Callers must avoid mutation between preparation and execution; detached copying is not promised.

Weight shape checks do not certify provenance. No pretrained downloads or historical predictive parity. Callers must set num_workers=0 and bound Torch, native pools and OpenCV for the shared resource budget; source defaults do not enforce that budget.

The field named probabilities is a source-weighted sum that can exceed one; it is not a calibrated posterior. Diagnostic threshold sweeps do not replace the fixed final threshold. No trained model is returned for later reuse.
Automated Tier 3 synthetic execution only; no human Tier 1, community Tier 2 or historical accuracy claim.
Both full variants are required, each with one explicit epoch per fold and random initialization; default 35/40-epoch schedules and external pretrained states are not empirically qualified.
Fixed spatial interpolation, shifted targets, loss masking, source fold selection, terminal-checkpoint policy and unnormalized weights remain recipe choices.
Validation covers current-platform serial CPU execution; no GPU, large-input memory or clean-install qualification.
Stored corrected original graph executed with reviewed reuse bounds; publication and served selection remain separate gates.
One explicitly configured epoch per fold and random initialization; no default 35/40-epoch schedule or pretrained accuracy claim.
All selected full MaxViT/U-Net models, terminal checkpoint reloads and eight-way spatial inference run without stand-ins.
Unnormalized source ensemble sum and fixed threshold retained; no calibration or cross-domain accuracy claim.

resolved_source_corrections.temporal_windowing: Accept four selected ordered time frames per example; the single branch uses frame3 and the temporal branch uses all four. Replace the inaccurate five-frame window claim. Upstream selection, time spacing, input decoding and alignment are caller responsibilities.
resolved_source_corrections.false_color_generation: Apply the exact source inverted three-channel thermal-difference transform with fixed offsets/scales and no clipping, then source branch-specific resizing. This is a physical encoding assumption, not generic RGB normalization. Callers must preserve the channel scale and order; shape validation alone does not establish them.
resolved_source_corrections.2_5d_stacking: Arrange four three-channel frames into a spatial panel with frame order3,0 / 1,2. Keep temporal quadrants fixed under spatial augmentation. Replace the inaccurate fifteen-channel temporal stacking claim. The temporal network receives a three-channel spatial panel; the other branch receives a single three-channel frame.
resolved_source_corrections.u_net_architecture: Train both full MaxViT/U-Net branches across every selected fold, preserving source decoder/head differences, shifted-label geometry, augmented-loss masking, AdamW, scheduling, validation-break timing and terminal checkpoint reload. The source realization selects MaxViT rather than an interchangeable ConvNeXt alternative. It does not operate on a fifteen-channel input. Explicit shortened epochs and random initialization qualify execution only, not historical accuracy.
resolved_source_corrections.temporal_tta: Run eight-way spatial D4 probability averaging for each selected checkpoint; combine folds and branches using the exact unnormalized source weights and encode the strict0.5 decision as column-major run lengths. Replace temporal-window shifting with spatial rotations/flips. Threshold diagnostics do not replace the fixed final threshold, and weighted outputs are not calibrated probabilities.

qualification.reuse_decision: Other aligned thermal-image segmentation tasks may reuse the recipe only when the source physical encoding, temporal order, target meaning, transformation invariances and fold assumptions are justified. Domain-neutral keys and arrays do not remove those assumptions. Preparation and execution remain recipe adapters; generic spatial augmentation or mask encoding would need independent provider contracts and qualification before separate selection.
qualification.parameter_contract: Exact version-1 envelope with training, scoring, prediction, initialization and config. Config requires integer seed in [0,2**32); optional variant v43/v47, positive integer batch_size, nonnegative integer num_workers and integer epoch_limit in [1,35]. Qualification uses explicit batch_size=1, num_workers=0 and epoch_limit=1. Finite float32-compatible arrays shaped (4,3,256,256), with caller-defined ordered times and the source thermal-channel physical scale. False color is 1-((channel2-channel1+4)/6, (channel1-channel0+4)/9, (channel1-243)/60), without clipping or per-image normalization. At least ten ordered training examples and nonempty scoring/prediction populations. Training/scoring supply label and annotation_mean arrays shaped (1,256,256) in [0,1]. Globally distinct nonempty keys; source shuffled ten-fold selection and explicit v43/v47 branch-fold subsets. Explicit seed and initialization policy: random, supplied encoder states or supplied full-model states per selected fold. Complete MaxViT/U-Net models, source loss/schedule, terminal checkpoints and all selected folds. Optional epoch_limit explicitly shortens the schedule.
qualification.output_contract: Ordered per-example (1,256,256) unnormalized weighted fold/branch sums, plus column-major one-based run-length masks using strict threshold0.5 and the empty marker "-". Return variant, seed, initialization, epoch limit and per-fold optimizer-update summaries. The field named probabilities is a source-weighted sum that can exceed one; it is not a calibrated posterior. Diagnostic threshold sweeps do not replace the fixed final threshold. No trained model is returned for later reuse.
